top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Sanitation Inspection - Conducted Local Sanitation Official (26 TAC §746.3401(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current health inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver served a child in care food they had an identified allergy to, resulting in the child having an   allergic reaction.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During an investigation, it was determined that the method that the caregiver reached and placed the children on the cot was inappropriate.

top_violation_types.title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An employee released the wrong child to a designated person.
